Sunday Morning Coffee Jam

Kapolei, HI · Road

No-drop

Sunday Morning Coffee Jam is a road group ride in Kapolei, HI. It rolls every Sunday at 7:15 am from Chili's parking lot, Kapolei. About 35–40 miles, fast social group, no-drop, all abilities.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: fast social group, no-drop, all abilities. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Morning Coffee Jam group ride

A west-side Oahu Sunday ride, 35 to 40 miles, that calls itself a fast social group but is no-drop and open to all abilities. Route map is on the HBL listing. Organized through a Facebook group.
